versions.description_html:
Learn Azure Confidential Computing simply. Discover how Trusted Execution Environments and data-in-use encryption protect your workloads in the cloud.

Hello everyone, and welcome to another episode of Microsoft Knowledge Nuggets here on m365.fm. I’m your host, Mirko Peters.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Encryption Gap: Data in Use
  • Why the Cloud Needs a Private Room
  • The Trusted Execution Environment, Plain English
  • Attestation: Checking the Room Before You Trust It
  • Azure Building Blocks: VMs, Containers, and Services
  • Where Confidential Computing Fits, and Where It Doesn't
  • Put the Third Lock in Place

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Hidden Microsoft 365 and Azure Cloud Security Risks
